title: Capsule 11
description: Capsule 11 Aims To Modernize, Simplify and Seperate Certain Elements Of The Game. To Achive That Capsule 11 Uses Windows Dark Mode Grey Scales And Almost Glow-Like Accent Colors.
body:
No AI was used for this project.
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9c8020db2d179847b6c2c17676a390fb111eb06.png)
Capsule 11 was originally inspired by Windows 11's sleep and seperated look. Realizing that the exact reconstruction of this idea was basically impossible without upscaling every Miencraft texture there is we started searching for an alternative... and here it is!
![Tagline](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e1af637c0126103ab6b351003f8c2d5e3c5dad1.png)
Inspired by [Fluent UI](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/fluentui#/) combined with Windows 11 gray tones. This pack rips apart containers, rounds corners, smooths surfaces and enables a navigation in GUIs with just a quick glance.
![Known Issues](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8ae46aefedae569603bf15c54fafad5e1df3b35.png) - Pill Shadows Not Displaying Properly - Vanilla Instances Reporting Broken Pack - Crosshair Animation Breaking When Tabbing Out Of The Game
